facts.label: NFA
facts.desc: Hyper Tek-only asset. Highest in-game bonuses. Guaranteed minimum buyback value that grows with every sale.

facts.label: NFC
facts.desc: Created by Hyper Tek or licensed players. In-game bonuses included. Minimum buyback guaranteed.

facts.label: NFT
facts.desc: Player-created collectible. No in-game bonuses. No buyback guarantee. Tradeable on the marketplace.

facts.label: Commission
facts.desc: Platform fee varies per listing. Resales split: seller 86%, artist royalty 2%, +5% to buyback, platform 7%.

facts.label: Buyback Growth
facts.desc: +5% of each resale price is added to the asset's minimum buyback value. It only ever grows.

facts.label: Custodial Wallet
facts.desc: Hyper Tek auto-creates a crypto wallet for you on signup.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.subtitle: Welcome to the Hyper Tek Marketplace. Select a feature to learn more, then jump straight in.

features.label: NFAs / NFCs / NFTs
features.tagline: New to Web3.5 assets? Start here
features.intro: NFAs/NFCs/NFTs are digital artworks that ALL have Guaranteed Minimum buy-backs and in-game bonuses
details: **NFAs** (Non-Fungible Assets) are Hyper Tek-issued items.
**NFCs** (Non-Fungible Collectables) are licensed player and Hyper Tek-issued items.
**NFTs** (Non-Fungible Tokens) are user-created items.

features.label: The Marketplace
details: Browse a wide catalog of NFAs, NFCs, and NFTs: skins, weapons, specialists, spaceships, and more.
Filter by category, rarity, or price range to find exactly what you need.
Listings are fulfilled on-chain, so ownership transfers are instant and verifiable.

features.label: Auctions
details: Bid on rare assets that are only available through time-limited auctions.
A live countdown shows exactly how much time is left, every second counts.
Outbid others to secure legendary items that can't be bought any other way.

features.label: Trades
details: Propose or accept direct asset trades with other players which are fully on-chain.
Set the terms yourself: choose what you offer and what you want in return.
Browse open trade offers or post your own to find the perfect deal.

features.label: Quests
details: Take on quests to earn exclusive rewards and rare in-game assets.
Each quest has unique objectives which are explore, battle, or build your way to victory.
Build your collection strategically through skill, not just spending.

features.label: For Hire
features.tagline: Borrow assets or earn from yours
details: Rent powerful specialists or gear for a single mission without buying outright.
List your own idle assets for rent and earn passive income while you're away.
Flexible durations: hourly, daily, or per-mission agreements.

features.label: Bounty
features.tagline: Hunt targets, claim rewards, top the leaderboard
details: Accept bounties posted by other players or the system to earn crypto rewards.
Climb the bounty leaderboard to unlock exclusive titles and bonus payouts.
Post your own bounties to recruit skilled players for your objectives.
